issues.title: Cross Join Without Join Condition
issues.problem: The query performs a cross join between 'customers' and 'orders' tables without a proper join condition, resulting in a Cartesian product.
issues.fix: SELECT c.customer_name, t.transaction_date FROM sigma_analytics.dim_customer c JOIN sigma_analytics.fact_transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id

issues.title: Ambiguous Table Aliases
issues.problem: The table aliases 'customers' and 'orders' are not descriptive. It's unclear which tables they refer to.
issues.fix: SELECT c.customer_name, t.transaction_date FROM sigma_analytics.dim_customer c JOIN sigma_analytics.fact_transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id

issues.title: Lack of Comments
issues.problem: The query lacks comments explaining its purpose or logic.
issues.fix: SELECT c.customer_name, t.transaction_date FROM sigma_analytics.dim_customer c JOIN sigma_analytics.fact_transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id -- Join customers with their transactions

review.corrected_sql: SELECT c.customer_name, t.transaction_date FROM sigma_analytics.dim_customer c JOIN sigma_analytics.fact_transactions t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id -- Join customers with their transactions
review.summary: The query had a critical correctness issue due to a cross join without a condition. It also lacked readability due to ambiguous aliases and missing comments.
